projects.name: cloud-order-processing-system
projects.description: Event-driven order processing on Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.3: five services run a choreographed Kafka saga over DynamoDB, with a transactional outbox, idempotent consumers and a Lambda read path.
highlights: Stock is held, then payment captured; a failed capture releases the hold through a tested compensation path.
Each step writes its aggregate and outbox row in one DynamoDB transaction, and consumers dedupe on event id.
Deployable with Terraform (VPC, MSK Serverless, ECS Fargate, Lambda) or an AWS SAM template.

projects.name: enterprise-customer-management-platform
projects.description: A B2B CRM with accounts, contacts, interactions and a deal pipeline, built as a Spring Boot 3.3 API, a React 18 + TypeScript SPA and MySQL 8, with Terraform for AWS ECS Fargate.
highlights: Two-level authorization: route-level role rules plus a service-layer ownership check, so a sales rep edits only their own records.
15-minute JWT access tokens and rotating refresh tokens that revoke the whole chain when one is replayed.
Pipeline dashboard from nine SQL aggregates behind a 60-second cache.

projects.name: planprice
projects.description: Monthly AWS cost estimates and cost diffs for Terraform plans, computed offline from a pinned AWS price snapshot, with Markdown output ready to post on a pull request.
highlights: Maps EC2, EBS, RDS, S3, NAT, ELB and Lambda resources to billable components; anything unpriced is listed, never treated as $0.
A CI gate exits non-zero when the monthly increase passes a dollar or percent threshold.
95.1% coverage of internal packages, with fuzz and property tests for every parser.

projects.name: pipeline-guard
projects.description: A shift-left security gate for CI that scans container images and infrastructure-as-code on every pull request, scores the findings against a threshold, and blocks the merge.
highlights: Normalizes Trivy, Dockerfile, Terraform plan and Kubernetes findings into one severity-weighted score.
Posts a Markdown PR comment per finding and can commit mechanical fixes to an auto-fix branch.
Packaged as a GitHub Action and a CLI, covered by 65 tests.

projects.name: gatekeep
projects.description: A BeyondCorp-style identity-aware reverse proxy in Go. Every request is authorized on who is calling, from what device and what it asks for, using OIDC with PKCE and CEL policies.
highlights: Strict ID-token validation, AES-256-GCM encrypted session cookies and a hash-chained audit log.
Ships a minimal OIDC provider, a posture agent and an offline end-to-end demo.

projects.name: previewd
projects.description: A Kubernetes controller that builds an ephemeral preview namespace per pull request from signed GitHub webhooks. It cleans up on close or TTL expiry.
highlights: Each namespace gets a ResourceQuota, LimitRange, NetworkPolicies, Pod Security labels and a TTL label.
Tested against a real kube-apiserver with envtest and run offline in a demo.

projects.name: quarry
projects.description: A vectorized SQL query engine over Apache Arrow, written from scratch in Rust. It includes a parser, typed binder, rule-based optimizer, hash join and hash aggregate.
highlights: All 22 TPC-H-like queries, 93 feature queries and thousands of random queries return the same rows as SQLite.
Join reordering by estimated cardinality: DPsub up to 10 relations, greedy beyond.

projects.name: swimring
projects.description: A from-scratch Go implementation of SWIM gossip membership with Lifeguard, a consistent-hash ring and a quorum-replicated cache. It runs over UDP or a deterministic network simulator.
highlights: N/W/R quorum replication (3/2/2) with last-writer-wins, read repair and hand-off.
No dependencies outside the Go standard library; coverage gate of 80% or more.

projects.name: tailsample
projects.description: A tail-based trace sampler in Rust that receives spans over OTLP/gRPC and HTTP. It buffers them in bounded memory, decides with ordered policies and exports the traces it keeps.
highlights: Nine policy kinds, including composite policies with per-policy span budgets.
Backpressure through retryable OTLP errors instead of unbounded buffering.

projects.name: sigmaforge
projects.description: A Sigma detection-rule compiler in Python. It parses rules into a typed expression tree and renders Splunk SPL, Elastic EQL, Microsoft KQL and SQLite SQL.
highlights: The SQL backend is checked against a reference evaluator by property-based differential tests.
684 tests plus mypy --strict and a coverage gate in the check target.

projects.name: minirun
projects.description: A minimal OCI-style Linux container runtime in Go. It builds containers from namespaces, cgroup v2, overlayfs, pivot_root, capabilities and a seccomp BPF compiler.
highlights: Seccomp profiles compile to classic BPF in pure Go for x86-64 and arm64.
Lifecycle commands: run, exec, ps, kill and delete.

projects.name: marginbridge
projects.description: A price-volume-mix margin bridge plus price elasticity estimated against discount confounding. It is scored against a synthetic ground truth.
highlights: The bridge reconciles exactly, with any residue reported as its own component.
In the demo, the corrected elasticity intervals cover the true value in every segment.

projects.name: surgecapacity
projects.description: A discrete-event simulation of emergency department staffing. It reports p95 wait and breach probability across triage levels and demand surges, instead of the mean.
highlights: A demand-shaped roster with the same 1,512 clinician-hours cut p95 wait from 4.42h to 2.05h.
Simulator validated against closed-form M/M/c results.
